article.title: 2-Digit IQs
article.author: Mark Bird
article.content: The opinions expressed here are solely the author's and do not reflect the opinions or beliefs of the LA Progressive. All U.S. generals and admirals have 3-digit IQs. Many are graduates of military academies and/or prestigious universities. IQ can be a factor at every level of military rank advancement. Generals and admirals have studied warfare for decades. Hence, before the Iranian War started, they knew: The U.S. lost the Vietnam and Afghan wars The Iran-Iraq War lasted from 1980 to 1988. This implies Iran can endure a long war. Iran used chemical weapons in this war The Iranian people are far more educated than were the Vietnamese or Afghan people. This implies Iran can devise more advanced retaliation Iran’s population is about equal to the combined population of North Vietnam and Afghanistan or over twice the population of California Hitler’s massive bombing of London and the US massive bombing of North Vietnam intensified resistance A US Pearl Harbor style attack on Iran would likely intensify resistance If one is wounded in an attack and his father (the Ayatollah) is killed in the attack, the son is highly likely to intensify resistance A war with Iran would cause unforeseen civilian casualties like the bombing of the Iranian school for girls—which intensifies resistance Iran had a large and highly advanced drone warfare arsenal Iran might blockade the Strait of Hormuz and get Russian assistance A war with Iran might lead to a shortage of US missile defense munitions or expand into a larger regional war. It is unwise to fire multiple generals and admirals before a war Prudent military planning emphasizes the retaliatory options of the adversary. Iran has had over 30 years to plan multiple options. One Iranian option is for anonymous agents in or outside of Iran to wreck the electrical or water system of a large US city Another option is for sleeper Iranian cells in the US to release bioweapons in Washington DC. Many or most people with a degree in chemistry could devise such weapons with funding. Retaliation need not originate by Iran or people connected to Iran. There are around 50 Muslim-Majority nations. A billionaire or multi-millionaire in any of these nations could hire someone to hire others to attack the USA. In litigation tactics, football, chess and other human pursuits it is fundamental to think of options of the opponent. As the author has never been in the military, generals and admirals would likely see other peril before the US started the war with Iran. It seems likely most are not impressed with the 2-digit military IQ and the 2-digit moral IQ of Secretary Hegseth and President Trump. Postscript : The author does not intend to belittle billions of people with a 2-digit IQ. He recognizes IQ is influenced by multiple factors including genetics, parental socioeconomic status, quality of parenting, quality of schools and luck.
